trailhead.label: Helmjet gondola top station, the board’s start

cautions: A descent of about 740 m: hard on joints and paws, take it slowly.
Summer 2026: the board warns of heavy construction traffic on path 4 while the new Helmissimo gondola is built: keep your dog close on the forest road.
The last stretch is on quiet paved roads into Sexten.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
